statement: A company's directors (or a majority of them) may apply under s 1003 for the registrar to strike the company off the register, but the application must not be made if at any time in the previous 3 months the company has changed its name, traded or otherwise carried on business, or disposed for value of property it held for disposal for gain in the normal course of trading; making the application in breach of the restriction is an offence (Companies Act 2006 ss 1003, 1004).
caveat: Section 1005 bars the application while winding up, administration, voluntary-arrangement and similar proceedings are pending, s 1006 requires copies of the application to be given to members, employees, creditors and other listed persons on pain of an offence, and the registrar strikes the company off no earlier than 2 months after a Gazette notice inviting objections (s 1003(3)). Assets left in the company at striking off pass as bona vacantia. This repo does not file or time a strike-off.
